rows.grounds: compound: godā (Godavari river) + avadya/tata (bank) + itaḥ (gone-to); morphology indicates arrival at riverbank, fitting ritual context of snāna
absolutive of snā (to bathe); corresponds to snāna in ritual sequence noted in transmission brief
